python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("tests/codegen/spl/exception_trace.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    assert_eq!(out.exit_code, Some(255));
    let report = &out.located_diagnostics;'''
new = '''    assert_eq!(out.exit_code, Some(255));
    // The block lands in the PROGRAM stream: its lines carry no `Warning:`-style kind prefix, so
    // the harness's diagnostic split leaves them where php wrote them.
    let report = &out.stdout;'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''    assert!(
        out.located_diagnostics
            .contains("DirectoryIterator->__construct('missing-dir')"),
        "{}",
        out.located_diagnostics
    );'''
new = '''    assert!(
        out.stdout
            .contains("DirectoryIterator->__construct('missing-dir')"),
        "{}",
        out.stdout
    );'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("assertions moved to the program stream")
